strengths: Python JMLE is completion-marked before FACETS and survives both retry exhaustion and nonretryable FACETS failure.
Retry eligibility is restricted to exit-0/missing-report failures and every try is retained.
StatisticalEvidenceReady, CalibrationReady, and PairFullyQualified are separate machine-readable gates.
Repository dependency code and the FACETS binary are bound beyond the v1 top-level-script hash.
remaining_limits: The conservative lock encloses the legacy pair call, so Python is recomputed under the FACETS lock after an independent Python fit.
The component is repository-only and is not yet wired into the public Streamlit workflow.
The pilot uses one retained target dataset and injected operational faults; it is not a population-level reliability-rate study.
Passing this remediation gate does not retroactively qualify the failed confirmatory batch or change H6 from 99 pairs.
decision: Eligible for a separately registered fresh-replicate H6-only runner. Not eligible for retroactive evidence replacement or broad production claims.
